hooks.command:
jq -r 'if .tool_input.command | startswith("pip ") then {hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "deny", permissionDecisionReason: "Use uv instead of pip.

Examples:
  pip install package → uv add package
  pip install -e . → uv sync
  pip list → uv pip list
  pip freeze → uv pip freeze"}} else {continue: true} end'

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git (commit|push)'; then branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "main 브랜치 직접 commit/push 금지 — feature 브랜치를 생성하세요: git checkout -b feature/..."}}'; fi; fi
